card.name: Small words before an expected next word
card.fires_on: Common small words such as the, to, are, her, and occasionally mid-name pieces, in general web or historical text, where the next word starts with a prefix like ad-, sup-, or bus-.

modes.label: Linking words
modes.description: Articles, prepositions or verbs like the, to, are, her in running prose.
modes.example: voted to tender the whole military power of the State to the President for the support of<< the>> Con Jan. 13.—

modes.label: Other short words
modes.description: Adjectives, nouns or name pieces before a following noun.
modes.example: is of paramount importance to<< modern>> society.learn more > >

card.writes: It slightly favors next words beginning with ad-, sup-, bus-, cl- and det-, and disfavors words beginning with bot-, sim- and com-.
card.plain: It fires on ordinary short words in running text and nudges the model toward certain word beginnings next.
